content:
The FoC – Future of Construction project is highlighted in the TECH3 programme, broadcasted on Sundays in RTP3.

The programme dedicates 2 episodes to this SIAC project led by BUILT CoLAB that aims to define the strategy for the Twin Transition of the AEC sector, based on four structural vectors: Digitalise, Transform, Preserve and Qualify.

The first episode broadcasted on 23 October 2022 focuses on the Digitalise and Preserve pillars, with contributions from Miguel Taborda, from Deloitte, and António Lorena, from 3drivers, who talk about the prospective studies for the AEC Sector that are being conducted by these two consultants. In this episode João Moutinho, BUILT CoLAB Director, and Rita Moura, from BUILT CoLAB Management, representing Teixeira Duarte, also contribute to the presentation of the project, as well as reflecting on the current state of the sector and which path to follow in the future.

You can review this video on RTP Play here or on BUILT CLAB’s Youtube channel:

https://youtu.be/Mi_t5KWipfw

This video presentation of the FoC project was produced by Bubble, and supported by: Teixeira Duarte, Mota-Engil, FI Group, EY, Deloitte and 3drivers.
